verdict.rationale: Secureframe's own Trust Center docs say control data, such as monitoring checks on security controls, is pulled continuously from the platform, so the control-status part of the story is covered. The pack says nothing about subprocessor lists or document renewals syncing to the Trust Center automatically. Shadow-IT detection keeps the internal vendor list current, but no evidence says that list feeds a published subprocessor page, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: automatic subprocessor list publishing on the Trust Center, automatic document renewal and refresh on the Trust Center, independent or hands-on corroboration of auto-sync behavior.
